policy.note: Only forecasts first observed before match start are admitted. Historical closed matches from before ledger activation are never backfilled. Radar model forecasts and market locks are stored separately and never overwrite one another. Technical duplicate rows are retained for audit but ignored in statistics.
policy.paper_candidate_note: Paper candidate metrics evaluate every settled pre-match market candidate at flat 1u using the locked candidate odds. They are validation-only and never count as official VALUE/STRONG VALUE picks.
